verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is documented only as an email client for Gmail and Outlook accounts. Nothing in the evidence shows SMS, WhatsApp, social or live-chat channels inside the inbox. The mentions of "social network updates" refer to auto-labeling and archiving notification emails, which is not a social messaging channel, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
